```{r setup, include=FALSE}

#question2

#  parameters
true_mean_1 <- 1
true_mean_2 <- 1.5
sample_size_x <- 25
sample_size_y <- 30
standard_deviation <- 2
prior_shape <- 0.1
prior_rate <- 0.1
large_c <- 10000
total_shape <- sample_size_x + sample_size_y + 1


rate_parameter <- (((sum((X - true_mean_1)^2) / 2) + (sum((X - true_mean_2)^2) / 2) + ((true_mean_1 - true_mean_2)^2) / (4 * large_c) + prior_rate))

#  posterior distribution
posterior_function <- function(std) {
  s <- std^2
  return((s^(-total_shape - 1)) * exp(-rate_parameter / s))
}

# Calculating kernel density using numerical integration
kernel_density_result <- integrate(posterior_function, 0, Inf)

# kernel density result
cat("Kernel Density:", kernel_density_result$value, "\n")






#question 3


#parameters
sample_size_x <- 10
sample_size_y <- 15
lambda_1_true <- 2
lambda_2_true <- 2.5
prior_shape <- 0.1
prior_rate <- 0.1
confidence_level <- 0.95

# Simulate data
X <- rpois(sample_size_x, lambda_1_true)
Y <- rpois(sample_size_y, lambda_2_true)


alpha <- prior_shape + sum(X)
beta <- prior_rate + sum(Y)

#samples from the posterior distribution of U = lambda_1 / (lambda_1 + lambda_2)
U <- rbeta(1e4, alpha, beta)

# Plot the density of U
plot(density(U), main = "Density Plot of U")

#mean of U
mean_U <- mean(U)
cat("Mean of U:", mean_U, "\n")

# Calculate 95% HPD Credible Interval for U
lower_quantile <- qbeta((1 - confidence_level) / 2, alpha, beta)
upper_quantile <- qbeta(confidence_level / 2, alpha, beta)
cat("95% HPD Credible Interval for U:", lower_quantile, "to", upper_quantile, "\n")

# Calculate the probability that theta = 1/2
p <- dbeta(0.5, alpha, beta)

# Comparing the probability with the confidence level
p_significance <- p > confidence_level
cat("Probability that theta = 1/2 is greater than the confidence level:", p_significance,"\n")
```
